title: Project session-start mod: session.start awaits a plain /reload-plugins before the first request; classic.SessionStart returns reloadSkills and sessionTitle
base_rule: base_sha = the integration commit the allocation commit is built on; the worktree is cut from the allocation commit
import_source: skills audit 2026-10-14 (session scratchpad skills-audit/report.md) and the frontier-scheduler scope proposal
delivers: a skills-dir plugin at .claude/skills/session-start/ (.claude-plugin/plugin.json with defaultEnabled true, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/register.ts, a reference SKILL.md) that loads on 2.1.300 without editing .claude/settings.json
session.start awaits $.command.run reload-plugins (plain, never --force) in interactive sessions before the first request, and reports a held or rejected reload as a status message

classic.SessionStart returns reloadSkills on startup and clear, and sessionTitle on startup when no title was given (claude -n wins): ccm-<local time %Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%N, hour offset> per D61 and D76, produced by the OS date command (one format string shared with dev/handoff.py next-name; ADR 0008, no logic in the mod)
no settings SessionStart hook for /clear (D92, D103 replace D61's hook route); the doctor's existing SessionStart hook stays

acceptance recorded: claude plugin validate --strict .claude/skills/session-start rc 0 and claude plugin list shows session-start@skills-dir; the live check (reload before the first request, a prompt typed during start waits, the title appears, /cost prompt-cache line without a miss) is the user's restart onto 2.1.300, recorded after it
no .agents/skills mirror (Codex cannot run mods); the parent adds that exception to .claude/AGENTS.md
notes: scope from the frontier-scheduler proposal 2026-10-14 (scratchpad skills-audit/report.md S1-S13; R3-await-plugin-reload.md; R1-mod-loading-gaps.md)
stands alone as a skills-dir plugin because the mods library (CT-31a) is unbuilt; it moves onto the library when CT-31a lands (parent decision D187 under D186)
reference only: the dotfiles session-start mod queues --force reloads unawaited, the shape D103 rejects; do not copy it
2.1.300 docs and types are not on disk; use the 2.1.299 copies in the session scratchpad research5/R1/docs and the 2.1.296 mod types; record any API you could not confirm
cut the worktree with git worktree add, never isolation worktree (#92533 unverified on this host); the mod registers no tool.call hook
